secrets.description: Public app-identity key that identifies PuzzleChain to the Usernode dApps-integration surface; returned alongside HMAC-signed integration payloads so callers can attribute them to this app. Public (non-secret); set the production value in Settings → Secrets. Staging uses a well-known Hardhat account #1 address.

Secret app-identity key used to HMAC-sign payloads PuzzleChain sends to the Usernode dApps-integration surface; an empty value disables the integration gracefully. Treated as an opaque HMAC key (any format works). Set the production value in Settings → Secrets. Staging uses a dummy (Hardhat account #1 key).
